variants.label: Current (live)
variants.description: Same MP3s kids hear today — may sound quiet or muffled on some phones.

variants.label: Bright & clear
variants.description: Louder target, no silence trim, slight high-mid boost — clearer on phone speakers.

variants.label: Minimal mastering
variants.description: Only loudness normalize + light limiter — keeps more natural ElevenLabs tone.

variants.label: Crisp (gentle trim)
variants.description: Softer silence trim (-50dB) with slightly louder norm — less squashed than current.

variants.label: Warm & full
variants.description: Less treble cut, warmer body — good if bright sounds too sharp.
